verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own bulk user imports and exports for database connections. That is a real bulk operation across many user records. However, the evidence frames it only as user migration, and shows no general bulk update, delete or assign operations across other items, nor bulk actions through the CLI or MCP server. A community report notes that getting an export with password hashes required a support ticket. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond user import/export (e.g., bulk role assignment, updates or deletes), bulk execution via CLI/MCP for AI-native workflows, detailed docs on limits and job handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Migrate users from an existing database or service to Auth0 using bulk imports for database connections.
